tests: 8 combined tests passed, covering runtime schema validation, deterministic sampling, UPSM correlation, observed call/event/state evidence, privacy redaction, malformed traces, and static workflow regression

benchmark_outcomes.name: sampling determinism
benchmark_outcomes.details: Blake2b-derived event sampling is deterministic and bounded by sample rate.

known_limitations: Runtime evidence is optional and observed-only; it is never interpreted as exhaustive behavior.
